flag_forms.repeated_flag: INVALID_INPUT unless the flag declares repeatable: true

pane.summary: a pane UUID, group/name, or tmux pane id %N; resolved to a UUID

cursor.summary: opaque cursor from an earlier gashki result

page-cursor.summary: opaque cursor from meta.pagination.cursor of an earlier status result; encodes the last name returned

doctor.description: Check tmux, pane label support, agent CLIs, logins, Codex hook trust and the state dir.

spawn.description: Start an agent in a tmux pane with gashki hooks installed; --here places it beside the caller.

flags.name: --trust-folder
flags.rule: explicit permission to answer only a verified folder trust screen for the full --cwd path

flags.name: --env
flags.rule: copy a caller environment variable used for configuration; do not pass secrets

pane_labels.other_supported_versions: spawn succeeds without a label and warns PANE_LABEL_UNAVAILABLE

spawn.remediation_command: When a full corrective command can be built, show the caller's spawn command with flags in declared order and --json retained. Substitute observed paths and tmux error text; never show spec placeholders. For a different server, omit --tmux-socket from the command.

examples.summary: start Claude Code in pane work/a

status.description: List gashki panes with state, safety and a recommended action.

raw.summary: one line of plain text for status-right, counts over all panes

send.description: Paste a prompt into an idle agent pane, submit it, and confirm the submit.

kill.description: Kill a gashki pane and its agent.

observe.description: Read one pane's turn state, screen state and hook evidence.

wait.description: Block until a pane reaches a state or changes.

examples.summary: wait for the turn to end

schema.description: Return JSON Schemas for the envelope, meta, shared types and each verb's data.

config.description: Read, validate and change the config file.

schema.description: Return the config file JSON Schema.

validate.description: Validate a config file. A named file must exist.

raw.summary: resolved settings as TOML; save it and pass it back with --config

set.description: Set one key in the config file, keeping comments and order.

patch.description: Apply a JSON merge patch (RFC 7396) from stdin to the config file.

edit.description: Open the config file in $EDITOR, then validate it.

conformance.description: Run the make-cli release self-check against this binary in a sandbox.

feedback.description: Record friction or a defect report in the local feedback file.

hook-event.description: Internal: record one agent hook event. Called by agent hooks, not by users.

raw.summary: empty stdout; faults go to stderr; always exit 0

UNKNOWN_FLAG.summary: flag not declared for the global position or the verb

INVALID_INPUT.summary: malformed selector; value of the wrong type or outside its domain; arity fault; repeated flag; both flags of an exclusive pair; payload empty (after send drops leading and trailing whitespace), over 1 MiB, or not UTF-8; a verb and selector pair not declared

MISSING_REQUIRED.summary: required positional or flag absent; neither flag of an exactly-one pair

INVALID_CONFIG.summary: config file is missing (a named path only) or unreadable, does not parse, has an unknown key, or has a bad value

TTY_REQUIRED.summary: config edit without a terminal on stdin and stdout, or under a CI signal

diagnosis_order.tiebreak: the fault at the earliest argv position wins
missing positionals before missing flags; flags in declared order
config load (INVALID_CONFIG) first, then the verb's own step order; verbs that do not touch a pane never reach pane codes

ts_iso.summary: UTC RFC 3339 with milliseconds and Z, the time the handler started; SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH fixes it

pagination.summary: always on status: {cursor, has_more, total}; cursor is null when has_more is false

truncated.summary: on status when the limit clipped the list: {by_limit: true, omitted: n}

keys.command: string, a paste-ready gashki or tmux command in --flag=value form, without --json
keys.rationale: string, one fixed sentence per case
keys.is_destructive: boolean; true only for gashki kill
keys.alternatives: array of {command, purpose}; may be empty

config.missing_file: not an error for the default path; an error for a path the caller names (--config, or the config validate argument), except config set, patch and edit

GASHKI_STATE_DIR.purpose: set by spawn in the pane; hook-event reads it; doctor reads it only to warn that it no longer selects a setting; not a setting

GASHKI_TMUX_SOCKET.purpose: retired; doctor reads it only to warn that it no longer selects a setting; not a setting

GASHKI_READY_TIMEOUT.purpose: retired; doctor reads it only to warn that it no longer selects a setting; not a setting

GASHKI_WAIT_TIMEOUT.purpose: retired; doctor reads it only to warn that it no longer selects a setting; not a setting

GASHKI_CONFIG.purpose: retired; doctor reads it only to warn that it no longer selects a setting; not a setting

GASHKI_PANE_ID.purpose: the pane's UUID, set by spawn; not a setting; doctor reads it only to tell a spawned pane

CODEX_HOME.purpose: caller Codex config root copied into the agent pane when set
CODEX_HOME.precedence: caller environment over tmux server environment

CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR.purpose: caller Claude config root copied into the agent pane when set
CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR.precedence: caller environment over tmux server environment

TMUX.purpose: the tmux client uses its socket when no tmux_socket setting is set; hook-event needs it

TMUX_PANE.purpose: identifies the caller pane on the caller tmux server

TMUX_TMPDIR.purpose: read by the tmux client for the socket dir; passed through

TMPDIR.purpose: root for the sandbox temp dirs

HOME.purpose: base of default paths when an XDG root is unset

XDG_STATE_HOME.purpose: root for the default state dir
XDG_STATE_HOME.precedence: below the gashki setting or flag

XDG_CONFIG_HOME.purpose: root for the default config file

XDG_DATA_HOME.precedence: none; the feedback path is not a setting

CI.purpose: true (any case) disables ANSI and prompts

SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH.purpose: fixes meta.ts_iso and event at values

spawn_env_transfer: Set caller values override the tmux server environment after the inherited Gashki and Claude variables are removed; spawn then sets GASHKI_PANE_ID and GASHKI_STATE_DIR; unset requested values fail and empty requested values pass.
